{{Quote|The Calabar Queen exploded without warning as it entered final approach to Cadomai, a small resort world located on the Hydian Way. Justice Action League terrorists claimed responsibility for the act, and stated in a press release that since the Empire was bringing its military might to bear on independent worlds of the Colonies and Outer Rim Territories, they were bringing their war of terror to the Core Worlds in retaliation.|A [[Galaxy News Service]] report|<ref name="GNN10" />}}
In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the terrorist group [[Justice Action Network]] '''sabotaged''' the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Calabar Queen]]'' that exploded as it entered final approach to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cadomai Prime/Legends|Cadomai Prime]]. The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] carried several [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], [[Governor/Legends|governors]] and high-ranking [[Officer/Legends|officers]] who died in the attack. The Justice Action Network later claimed responsibility for the terrorist strike and declared it was a retaliation for the Imperial subjugations of independent worlds in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Imperial Transport Commission]] was quickly assigned to investigate the explosion and confirm the sabotage. In spite of the Imperial promises of actions, the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] citizen began to fear terrorist actions in the Core Worlds.
